# `care_signup`

Area: **selfcare** ([all tables](README.md))

One online signup (self-care, issue 377): email verified with a code, the person and service address, the identity check, the first payment and the eSIM line; resumable, it keeps the ids of what it created.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `email` | `text` | no |  | The email the signup started with, lower case; the self-care login gets it. |
| `state` | `text` | no | `'started'::text` | started (email not verified), identityPending (the check is with the adapter), identityPassed (pay; a declined card stays here), identityFailed, identityReview (an operator decides), paid (the first top-up is confirmed), activating (the order waits for the network), active, failed (failure_code says why), expired (24 hours without progress before payment). |

| `client_address` | `text` | no |  | The address the signup came from: the limit of 10 signups an hour per address. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `care_signup_check` | check | `CHECK (((state = 'failed'::text) = (failure_code IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `care_signup_check1` | check | `CHECK (((state = ANY (ARRAY['started'::text, 'expired'::text])) OR (email_verified_at IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `care_signup_check2` | check | `CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'activating'::text, 'active'::text])) OR (billing_account_id IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `care_signup_check3` | check | `CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['activating'::text, 'active'::text])) OR (product_order_id IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `care_signup_email_check` | check | `CHECK (((email <> ''::text) AND (email = lower(email))))` |
| `care_signup_email_code_attempts_check` | check | `CHECK ((email_code_attempts >= 0))` |
| `care_signup_service_address_check` | check | `CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(service_address) = 'object'::text))` |
| `care_signup_state_check` | check | `CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['started'::text, 'identityPending'::text, 'identityPassed'::text, 'identityFailed'::text, 'identityReview'::text, 'paid'::text, 'activating'::text, 'active'::text, 'failed'::text, 'expired'::text])))` |
